title: Material prices
subtitle: Each supplier's paper and the glues, with their price per kilo. The order form starts from these prices; an order keeps the ones it was calculated with.
emptyText: Add each supplier's paper and the glues: the order form will start from their prices.
openHint: Click a material to see its history, change its price or edit it.

detail.archiveBody: It will no longer be offered in the order form and loses its default lines. Orders already calculated keep their price.
detail.restoreBody: It will be offered in the order form again. Its default lines are not brought back.
detail.archivedNote: Archived: it is no longer offered in the order form and its price cannot change.

form.label: Label
form.grammageHint: Empty: the price holds for every grammage of this paper from this supplier.
form.defaultsHint: The order form prefills these lines with this glue. A line has one default glue: ticking it here takes it off the other.
form.createNote: This price starts the material's history; afterwards it changes through "New price".
form.typeNote: The type cannot change once the material exists.

price.title: New price
price.note: The old price ends at the moment the new one starts. Orders already calculated keep their price.
price.conflict: The price was changed in the meantime: it is now {price}. Check it and try again.
price.unchanged: That is already the current price.
